title: Custom RFID & NFC Manufacturer in China since 2008
summary: Proud Tek manufactures custom RFID tags, NFC stickers, smart cards, keyfobs, wristbands and readers from two self-owned factories in Shenzhen. The catalog spans 191 SKU variants across 6 product families and ships globally with chip-level customization, in-house encoding and ISO/IEC 14443 / 18000-6C compliance documentation included on every PO.
heroPoints: 18 years specializing in HF (NTAG, MIFARE, ICODE) and UHF (Monza, Higgs, UCODE) chip families.
Two self-owned factories in Shenzhen with in-house encoding, laser numbering and bespoke printing.
Global shipping coverage via DHL, FedEx, EMS and sea-freight options on every shipment.

sections.title: Six product families, one supplier
sections.intro: Proud Tek concentrates the catalog around the chip-housing combinations buyers ask about most often. The same wet-inlay lines that print NFC review stickers for restaurants also produce UHF inlays for pharmaceutical serialization, so single-vendor procurement is realistic across multiple deployments.
bullets: RFID Tags: anti-metal, high-temperature, on-asset, embedded.
RFID Labels: wet inlays, dry inlays, pre-printed, RFID-on-paper.
RFID Readers: desktop, handheld, fixed-mount, USB, OEM modules.
RFID Cards: MIFARE, NTAG, EM, dual-frequency, hotel keys, transit.
RFID Keyfobs: access, membership, OEM credential replacements.
RFID Wristbands: silicone, fabric, woven, paper, Tyvek, RFID-textile.

sections.title: How we differ from a trading house
sections.intro: Buyers come to Proud Tek when they want a chip-level conversation, not catalog forwarding. Five things let us close inquiries faster than the average Shenzhen sourcing channel.
bullets: Direct factory pricing: no middleman markup, transparent BOM breakdown on request.
In-house engineering: we read chip datasheets, not just spec sheets, and we will tell you when a chip family is wrong for your reader.
Sample-first sales motion: engineering-validated samples in 5–7 working days for stocked chips, with NDEF/UID encoding included.
Documentation discipline: RoHS, REACH, EU DPP, FCC, MIC and CE declarations issued per shipment without follow-up emails.
Reorder velocity: once a spec is locked, repeat orders ship in 10–14 days for stocked chip families.

faq.question: What is your minimum order quantity?
faq.answer: Standard MOQ for stocked chip families starts at 500 pieces for cards and 1,000 pieces for tags or labels. Sample orders below MOQ are available on a paid-sample basis when chip programming or housing customization is involved.

faq.question: Do you support OEM and white-label?
faq.answer: Yes. Most cards, keyfobs, wristbands and labels ship without Proud Tek branding by default. We support custom artwork, embossed numbering, laser engraving and bespoke packaging for resellers and integrators.

faq.question: How fast can samples arrive?
faq.answer: Stocked chip families with no custom housing usually ship within 5–7 working days from Shenzhen via DHL or FedEx. Custom shells, printing approvals or anti-metal lamination add 3–5 days.

faq.question: What chip families do you stock?
faq.answer: HF/NFC: NTAG 213/215/216/424 DNA, MIFARE Classic 1k/4k, MIFARE Plus EV2, MIFARE DESFire EV2/EV3, MIFARE Ultralight C/EV1, ICODE SLIX, EM4100/4200/4305. UHF: Impinj Monza M730/M750/M770/M800, {chip:alien-higgs-3:name}/4/EC/9, {chip:nxp-ucode-7:name}/8/9. We can usually source other chip families on request with longer lead times.

faq.question: Do you provide compliance documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. RoHS, REACH, FCC, CE, MIC and CCC declarations are issued per shipment. EU DPP technical files (Battery Regulation 2023/1542 / EU Construction Products Regulation) are available for relevant programs. Test reports from accredited labs (TÜV, SGS) can be commissioned for certification audits.
